notes.title: One of 2025's best RPGs just got a free tabletop version
notes.notes:
Between Clair Obscur: Exposition 33, The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy, and Like a Dragon: Pirate Yazuka in Hawaii, 2025 has been a pretty good year for RPGs. But one of the very best might be Citizen Sleeper 2. It's a melancholic, hopeful, and stressful spacefaring journey through a cyberpunk universe. Now, to celebrate the original game's third anniversary, studio Jump Over The Age has released a free tabletop RPG. All you'll need is the printed-out game document, 10 six-sided dice, and a pencil and eraser.
